=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url at lines 3038-3050, _resolve_origin_url at lines 3074-3084 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded in HTTPS clone URLs and passed to git subprocesses.
  WHY: The token is exposed in `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, git errors, exception text, and temporary `.git/config`; the prior credential-free `http.extraHeader` path avoided these surfaces.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url at lines 578-586, plus bare git clone/push/ls-remote at lines 148, 177, 624, 767, 883, 919 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN is interpolated into remote URLs while other memory git operations use unauthenticated bare git calls after `_memory_git` was removed.
  WHY: Token-bearing URLs leak credentials through process arguments, errors, and `.git/config`, while bare operations fail against private repositories and silently degrade memory branch operations.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path at lines 240-247, emit_context at lines 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`/`MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` limits were removed, and `emit_context` iterates caller-supplied paths without normalization or validation.
  WHY: Caller-controlled paths can inline `.git/config`, `.env*`, and credential files into model prompts, while unbounded path lists permit prompt inflation.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: line 1989 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth push origin "HEAD:${TARGET_BRANCH}"` is called after `git_with_github_auth` was removed from `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, the judge-fix push fails with `command not found`, stranding recovery commits.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30 and 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test imports deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Test collection fails with `ImportError`, preventing the targeted file context test module from running.

- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py: test_production_git_urls_do_not_embed_tokens at lines 51-55; test_networked_git_steps_use_ephemeral_authentication at lines 95-98 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The authentication hygiene tests still forbid credential-bearing URLs and require `_memory_git`, both of which the PR removed or violates.
  WHY: The tests fail against the current production scripts and no longer match the implemented authentication behavior.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: setup_editor_isolation at lines 122-168 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Editor isolation unconditionally requires passwordless sudo and the `nobody` account without an opt-out or fallback.
  WHY: Consumer runners lacking either prerequisite hard-fail every review run.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: lines 248-257 (`editor_path="${EDITOR_CODEX_PATH:-${PATH}}"`) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The isolated editor receives the runner's complete `PATH`, including potentially writable directories.
  WHY: A writable PATH entry can shadow `bash`, `python3`, or other commands executed by the unprivileged editor and expose `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`; severity disagreement exists, with deepseek rating MAJOR and minimax rating BLOCKER.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: line 64 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git restore --source=HEAD --worktree -- pre_assembled_static.txt` restores only the worktree and not the index.
  WHY: Staged deletions or modifications can survive the cleanup and be committed despite the preservation message; a staged new file can also make the restore fail.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: _parse_reset_header at lines 128-157 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_parse_reset_header` handles numeric `Retry-After` values but not HTTP-date values.
  WHY: Secondary-rate-limit responses with HTTP-date headers fall through to `X-RateLimit-Reset`, causing unnecessarily long waits; severity disagreement exists, with deepseek rating confidence 3 and minimax rating confidence 4.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 18094-18127 (merge_with_followup) and 18180-18204 (close_and_reissue) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Failed or inconclusive successor issue handling after a merge no longer provides the prior operator-facing error and Telegram warning path.
  WHY: A merged project can remain `ai:review-blocked` without a tracking issue or timely alert.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 17483-17501, 18094-18127; scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2256-2270, :2536-2568 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Successor preparation receives `${RB_APPROVAL_PRODUCER_ID:-0}`, which is rejected when producer resolution fails.
  WHY: The successor lookup becomes inconclusive and the project can remain permanently `ai:review-blocked` without warning.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: memory_ensure_branch (lines 140, 151, 180) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `memory_ensure_branch` captures a token but performs bare unauthenticated `git ls-remote` and `git push`.
  WHY: Private repository branch creation fails and is swallowed as a warning, so the memory branch is silently never created.

- scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh: lines 43-85 (`REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` / `MAIN_PRIMARY_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` loops) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `.codex-workflow-src-main` fallback for required and main-primary bootstrap scripts was removed.
  WHY: Older integration branches cannot self-heal from newer support fixes and now fail with incomplete diagnostics when a required script is missing.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: lines 1919-1926 and 2172-2176 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Editor-isolation cleanup runs both from the EXIT trap and explicitly per attempt, with incomplete child-path mode restoration.
  WHY: Interrupted or repeated cleanup can leave `.git` ownership and permissions inconsistent and allow unintended hook or metadata behavior.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 1948-2035 (`review_blocked_refusal_is_valid` + `post_review_blocked_refusal`) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Refusal validation performs per-comment Python/temp-file work and no longer accepts legacy V1 refusal markers.
  WHY: Poll cost scales with producer comments, and previously authoritative V1 markers no longer suppress repeated judge invocation.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: lines 17483-17501 (gate) vs 18094-18127 (adoption path) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Successor adoption or creation lacks an idempotency key when producer resolution changes across ticks or key rotations.
  WHY: The same review-blocked PR can produce duplicate successor issues or alternate between adoption and creation.

- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh: lines 22-34 (`RUNTIME_DIR` / `PR_CLOSED_SENTINEL_FILE` guards); lines 1920-1926 (boot) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Early required-environment guards can exit before the isolation cleanup trap is installed.
  WHY: A re-invocation after partial isolation can leave `.git` owned or protected by `nobody`, causing later repository operations to fail.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh + scripts/review_rb_judge.sh + scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: deletion of `git_with_github_auth`; callers at review_rb_judge.sh:1989, 2382, 2383; deletion of `review_blocked_find_issue_for_request` | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Existing helper interfaces were deleted or semantically replaced without preserving their callers' behavior.
  WHY: Consumer wrappers and standalone review-blocked flows can encounter `command not found` or inconclusive successor resolution.
